title: CD Storage Capacity Secrets

scenes.text: A single CD can hold more than 700 megabytes of data.
The common belief is that CDs can only store about 650 MB of music.
scenes.label: 650 MB limit myth

scenes.text: Standard 120 mm CDs are manufactured to hold up to 700 MB of data, with some extensions reaching 800 MB using over‑burn techniques.
scenes.label: 700 MB standard

scenes.text: Know your disc’s real limit before burning!
scenes.label: Check disc limit
scenes.sub: Avoid failed burns by verifying size
scenes.query2: how much data fits on CD

scenes.text: Follow to stay ahead of the tech curve.

description: People often cite a 650 MB cap for CDs, but the true standard is 700 MB. Learn the real numbers and keep your burns successful.
